reason: It's free and cafés sending me invites with the fee already written down beats haggling in DMs, so I'd sign up and switch on the local invites. I don't need the scam checker much, I can smell a fake DM by now.
objection: Kannada creators always get paid less than English ones, and if these local cafés and salons just offer the same small fees, or barter dressed up as a paid deal, nothing really changes for me. And who makes sure I actually get paid on time instead of chasing UPI for weeks?
